name: Harbor Steel & Supply Corporation
old_description: Serving our valued customers in Michigan, Southern Indiana, Ohio, Kentucky, and West Virginia with prime materials. We specialize in quality control, on-time delivery, and total satisfaction based customer service. Offering modern facilities and state of the art processing equipment, Harbor Steel and Supply can accommodate almost any requirement you may have.
about:
Harbor Steel & Supply Corporation, headquartered in Prichard, West Virginia, has operated as a family-owned metal service center since 1952. The company was founded on a commitment to quality, reliability, and long-term customer relationships across the Midwest and Southern United States.

The company supplies prime metals including hot-rolled, stainless, and aluminum, and provides advanced processing across six locations. Capabilities include tube and sheet laser cutting, beam cutting, oxy-fuel plate burning, saw cutting, shearing, forming, cold saw cutting, plasma cutting, bending, and grinding. With 6,000-plus active customers, Harbor Steel handles material preparation and precision processing for a wide range of project requirements.

Customers span industries throughout Michigan, Southern Indiana, Ohio, Kentucky, and West Virginia. The service center serves fabricators, manufacturers, and other metal-consuming sectors with inventory access and value-added processing from quote to delivery.

Harbor Steel emphasizes responsiveness, communication, and follow-through as differentiators rooted in its family-ownership model. The company states its mission centers on people and consistent results, supported by a customer portal for quote management and order tracking.
